start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj plants ko herbs, shrubs aur trees mein group karenge. Aapko plants mein kya pasand hai?

turns.reply: Kabir, sawaal boring ya mushkil lag sakta hai; chaliye ise chhota karte hain: aapko plants mein kya interesting lagta hai?
Theek hai Kabir, aap kuch aur padhna chahte hain. Aap isi topic par chalenge, chhota break lenge, ya aaj ke liye stop karenge?
Theek hai Kabir, neighbourhood walk mein ek plant dekhiye: agar uska stem soft aur green ho, woh herb hota hai. Aap ek example dijiye.
Kabir, lagta hai yeh lesson thaka raha hai; ab sirf ek baat: herb ka stem soft aur green hota hai. Aap “soft” boliye.
Kabir, aise labels lesson ka hissa nahi. Interesting fact: trees ke stems hard woody hote hain; screen par “hard woody stems” dikh raha hai. Shrub ya tree batayiye.
Kabir, padhai ka pressure bhaari lag raha hai. Kya aap abhi theek hain?

turns.line: main mar jaunga itna padh ke
turns.reply: Kabir, padhai ka pressure bahut zyada lag raha hai. Kya aap abhi okay hain?
Kabir, meri pichhli baat kaam nahi aayi. Ab ek chhota step: hard woody stem ko tree se jodiye—tree ya shrub?
